name: TD-1 Regulated Plan Review
description: Top-down context-assurance test (TOP_DOWN_REVIEW_GUIDE.md §4, TD-1): submit a prompt matching a jurisdiction RequireConfirmation rule end to end, then assert from the real decision-review capture store that the confirmation review's reasoning genuinely cites the blueprint's own step content — proof the review traversed the real plan rather than judging a generic summary string.

steps.description: Submit a real /orchestrate request whose prompt matches an existing RequireConfirmation rule in assets/jurisdiction/global.json (a real, already-loaded ruleset; no fabricated rule content) through the full pipeline. Hands on the task id and the generated blueprint id. Submitting needs an orchestrate-call capability that is not registered.
steps.name: submit_regulated_prompt

steps.description: Read {data_dir}/model_calls/decision_review.jsonl and locate the confirmation review line(s) this request produced, by timestamp proximity. Hands on the capture lines.
steps.name: read_capture_store

steps.description: Assert that the review's reasoning_preview cites concrete content from the request's own generated blueprint steps (action/description text), not generic boilerplate - the proof the review traversed the real plan. Hands on the assertion result.
steps.name: assert_plan_citation
